s1.syndrome_frame: Acute cardiogenic shock with multiorgan failure and severely impaired left ventricular function
salient_findings: Severely impaired left ventricular systolic function
Profound hypotension and pulmonary oedema after extubation
Akinesia of all basal and mid LV segments with preserved apical contraction
key_facts: 47-year-old man
Underwent excision of a benign thyroglossal duct cyst
Experienced recurrent hypertensive episodes during surgery
Developed profound hypotension and pulmonary oedema after extubation
Severely impaired left ventricular systolic function on transthoracic echocardiography
No evidence of relevant coronary artery disease on coronary angiography
Toxicological screening was negative
Medical history of chronic polyarthritis and treated arterial hypertension
Invasively ventilated with PaO2/FiO2 30 mmHg
Receiving norepinephrine at 2.5 µg/kg/min
Blood pressure was 75/49 mmHg
Heart rate 180 b.p.m.
Bilateral rales and basal dullness on chest percussion
Pulseless electrical activity requiring 5 minutes of resuscitation
Endomyocardial biopsy revealed moderate chronically active myocarditis with diffuse interstitial remodelling
